(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than 0.030 inches, and wherein the tapered fluid conduit is distinct from any other tapered fluid conduit defined in the column assembly.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit distinct from any other tapered fluid conduit.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal, and wherein the seal exhibits a defined degree of compliance suitable for maintaining a seal under operational conditions.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the seal. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi, and wherein the seal exhibits sufficient dimensional stability to perform reliably at said pressures.
